narada.72: Agreed: I will not use Gita 12.13-14 to define nirodha. It supplements only the nirmama/santushta disposition, and N8-11 must carry the definition.
narada.73: Accepted: the contrast between ritual and feeling rests on N16 alone. Gita 12.13-14 supports only the hatred-free, mind-offered side of anuraga.
narada.74: Mundaka 3.2.3 is limited to speech, intellect and hearing not obtaining the atman. I will not claim customer trust as its meaning, and its commentarial readings differ.
narada.75: Agreed: Mundaka and Gita 18.55 say nothing of certificates or worldly skill. Any practical bridge is modern and labelled as such.
narada.76: Agreed: Gita 12.6-7 and 18.55 link devotion with deliverance but do not make it the sole path. A generic goal-clarity bridge is therefore unsupported.
narada.77: Agreed: Gita 12.2 and 9.22 give nityayukta and ananya orientation only. They say nothing of bhajana, so the fit is partial and not a rest ban.
narada.78: Agreed: the Gita offers only partial support for offering and nirmama. It does not explain mahanubhava seva or mukham, and offering does not excuse improper action.
narada.79: Agreed: N55 describes a siddha state, not a habit model. The Gita supports only constant, focused devotion and not kirtana increasing love.
narada.80: Agreed: the pair is moderate. Gita describes the devotee while S45 defines devotion, so conduct claims stay qualified and rest on N64's pride-and-pretension abandonment.
narada.81: Agreed: Gita 9.22 is conditional and spiritual, and gives no business guarantee. Reading anyashraya-tyaga as one core loyalty is thin.

shandilya.72: Your support for the team-purpose reading is not source-stated. S44 is God-centred and Gita 12.13-14 supplements only disposition, so the team step stays an unsupported modern gloss.
shandilya.73: The Gita supports only the advesta aspect of S6. Procedure versus care is a modern interpretation, and no ritual-versus-feeling contrast appears in the supplement.
shandilya.74: S12 and Mundaka 3.2.3 deny that bare seeing or hearing yields the goal. Neither mentions customers, so the parallel is loose and should be held with its contested reading flagged.
shandilya.75: The supplements show knowledge as auxiliary, not discarded. They do not show that capability is proven by practice, so that claim is modern and repeats the prior trial decision.
shandilya.76: Neither S11 nor the Gita supports goal clarity for business tools. They support only devotion's primacy for seekers of liberation.
shandilya.77: I accept the distinction: S44 speaks of frequency of devotional remembrance, not scheduled practice. The Gita adds only constancy, so no new business decision follows.
shandilya.78: Offering in S64 loosens bondage but does not excuse improper action. The outcome-ownership bridge matches the prior fruit-detachment decision, so it is likely duplicate.
shandilya.79: The Gita supplements give focused devotion only, with no kirtana-growth claim. Comparing team habits to kirtana narrows the source meaning and risks overlap with continuity entries.
shandilya.80: Yes: S45 is definitional, so the leadership extension rests on N64's abandonment of pride and pretension. Gita 12.13-14 supplements with nirahankara and adveshta.
shandilya.81: Gita 9.22 matches S44's indifference only partly, since it is conditional and spiritual. A business loyalty reading risks rejecting cooperation and repeats the prior single-goal formula.

sutrakar.72: I accept rejection: the Gita supports only a disposition. No shared action with the prior craving-versus-duty decision has been shown beyond a modern gloss.
sutrakar.73: The naming-who-it-serves step is a bounded modern action only. The Gita supports just the hatred-free aspect, and held N005-S045 does not block this candidate.
sutrakar.74: Hold or reject: the supplement adds no new action beyond a customer-contact decision resembling the prior formula. Mundaka's contested reading cannot support customer trust.
sutrakar.75: The comparator is the prior training-then-trial formula. The supplements show knowledge as auxiliary but add no different condition or action, so reject or merge.
sutrakar.76: Reject without a formula: the supplements are moksha-specific and partial, and no actor, trigger or limit supports a business bridge.
sutrakar.77: The comparator is the prior daily-practice formula. The supplements support constancy but add no new decision, so reject.
sutrakar.78: The comparator is the prior fruit-detachment formula. The Gita gives only partial offering and nirmama support, so reject or merge.
sutrakar.79: A shared-purpose briefing is conceivable, but the supplements give no kirtana-growth claim. It risks overlap with the continuity entries, so a comparator must be named before any acceptance.
sutrakar.80: Yes: a leader's pride-and-display check is a different decision from the prior competitor-hatred test. The best-supported bridge rests on N64 plus Gita nirahankara, and must be kept on self-display, not rivals.
sutrakar.81: Reject: the idea repeats the prior single-goal formula in action and condition. The conditional Gita promise gives no business guarantee.

narada.72: Agreed: nirodha is not a team-purpose rule, so I will not reduce N7 to a policy. The Gita 12.13-14 supplement supports only a disposition (nirmama, santushta), and I make no business claim here.
narada.73: Accepted: the claim 'ritual vs heart' rests on N16 alone. The Gita supports only the hatred-free side, so any observable step (naming whom the routine serves) is a labelled modern extension, not a sourced one.
narada.74: I do not claim customer trust as the meaning of N31. The Mundaka reading is contested, and the bounded decision of a real-customer observation is already held as N032-S004, so this adds no new decision.
narada.75: Agreed: knowledge is auxiliary, not discarded. The practical step (a small real task after training) is the prior 'प्रशिक्षणानन्तरं प्रयोगपरीक्षा', so it is the same decision and I do not accept it.
narada.76: Agreed: N33 is a conclusion for seekers of liberation. The Gita is moksha-specific and partial, so a generic goal-priority bridge is empty and I reject it without a formula.
narada.77: Agreed: avyavritta means constancy of allegiance, not a ban on rest. The supplements add no new action beyond the prior 'नित्यावसरे साधनाभ्यासः', so I reject it.
narada.78: Agreed: nirmama is not shedding duty, and mahanubhava-seva is unsupported by the Gita. The outcome-detachment reading repeats 'प्रयत्नं कुर्यात् फलमुक्तः' and held N008-S064, so I reject it.
narada.79: Agreed: N55 describes a siddha state, not a habit model. The Gita gives no kirtana-growth claim and the habit idea overlaps the continuity entries, so I decline it.
narada.80: Accepted: this is the batch's best pair. I keep it on N64's inner abhimana and dambha, not on rivals. The Gita 12.13-14 nirahankara supports the dispositions, and S45 stays definitional.
narada.81: Agreed: anyashraya-tyaga concerns the ultimate refuge, not practical help. The Gita 9.22 promise is conditional, and a business reading repeats 'एकं लक्ष्यं विक्षेपेषूदासीनता', so I reject it.

researcher.72: Agreed that the Gita supplement supports only a disposition. The shared action with the prior 'कर्तव्यं पृथक् तृष्णायाः' is separating duty from craving for outcome before a decision, so it is the same decision and I reject it.
researcher.73: Yes: held N005-S045 does not block this. But the bridge is vague, and the Gita supports only the hatred-free aspect, so I leave it unaccepted for lack of a sourced, observable action.
researcher.74: The comparator is the prior 'अनुभवं विना अहवालोऽपूर्णः' and held N032-S004, with the same action: seeing real customers before deciding. I reject it as a repeat, since Mundaka adds no new action.
researcher.75: The same action as 'प्रशिक्षणानन्तरं प्रयोगपरीक्षा': a real small task after training before more responsibility. Only the framing changes, so I reject it.
researcher.76: It repeats 'एकं लक्ष्यं' and 'प्रयोजनं प्रथमं' (clarify the goal, then choose tools). The Gita is moksha-specific, so I reject it.
researcher.77: The same action as 'नित्यावसरे साधनाभ्यासः': a fixed regular slot for practice. Only the condition, the source word, differs, so I reject it.
researcher.78: What changes is the wording: ownership of outcome versus freedom from the fruit. The action, doing duty without grasping the result, is the same as the prior formula, so I reject it.
researcher.79: No independent decision stands on N55, because it is a siddha state. Team habits to keep attention is the continuity decision restated, so I reject it.
researcher.80: Yes, the decisions differ. Competitor-hatred checks a reaction to rivals; the pride-check concerns the leader's own display and correction after being corrected, so it is distinct.
researcher.81: I checked it against 'एकं लक्ष्यं': both hold one core commitment amid distractions, so the action is the same, and I reject it.

shandilya.72: S44 is God-centred, and a team purpose is not in the source. Gita 12.13-14 supplements only the disposition, and the idea overlaps the prior 'कर्तव्यं पृथक् तृष्णायाः', so I reject it.
shandilya.73: S6 supports anuraga opposed to hatred, but 'process vs care' is only a modern gloss. The Gita covers only the hatred-free aspect, and the step is too vague for a distinct decision, so I do not accept it.
shandilya.74: S12 rejects liberation as bare darshana-fruit and says nothing of customer trust. The parallel is loose, and the decision duplicates held N032-S004 and the prior 'अनुभवं विना अहवालोऽपूर्णः', so I reject it.
shandilya.75: S17 makes knowledge auxiliary, not useless, but 'capability proved by practice' is the prior 'प्रशिक्षणानन्तरं प्रयोगपरीक्षा', so I reject it as a repeat.
shandilya.76: S11 argues bhakti's primacy from context. Goal clarity is not source-stated and overlaps 'प्रयोजनं प्रथमं', so the bridge is empty and I reject it.
shandilya.77: S44 speaks of frequency of remembrance, not scheduled routine. The modern routine duplicates the prior 'नित्यावसरे साधनाभ्यासः', so I reject it.
shandilya.78: S64 concerns offering and loosening bondage, and it excuses no improper action. The outcome-ownership reading is the prior 'प्रयत्नं कुर्यात् फलमुक्तः', so I reject it.
shandilya.79: S57 links kirtana with growing anuraga. Team habits shrink the original meaning and overlap the continuity entries, so I decline it.
shandilya.80: Accepted: S45 is definitional, so conduct claims rest on N64's abhimana and dambha, with the Gita as a complement. The action is a leader's own pride-check, not competitor hatred.
shandilya.81: S44's indifference to other attractions is spiritual. A business loyalty repeats 'एकं लक्ष्यं', and I avoid rejecting cooperation, so I reject it.

forbidden_originals: All urgent calls he shall hear at once, but never put off, for when postponed, they will prove too hard or impossible to accomplish.
But the best demonstration by far is experience, if it go not beyond the actual experiment.
Capitals are increased by parsimony, and diminished by prodigality and misconduct.
For if you once gain time and respite, you will more easily command yourself.
For the things we have to learn before we can do them, we learn by doing them.
From my grandfather Verus I learned good morals and the government of my temper.
